specs.title: Dashboard shell
specs.why: Owner-facing features need a consistent authenticated frame before they can be built independently.
specs.scope: Create the authenticated layout at `/app`: sidebar (Today, Calendar, Clients, Services, Settings), top bar with tenant name and logout, mobile-first responsive design with a drawer on small screens.
tasks: Build the `(app)` route group with an auth guard
Implement the sidebar component with active state
Implement the top bar with a user menu
acceptance: Navigation works on desktop and mobile
Lighthouse mobile score is 90 or above
A visual regression test is checked in

specs.title: Services CRUD
specs.why: Services are the unit customers book, so they must exist before availability or booking work.
specs.scope: Owner can create, edit, archive and delete services. Fields: `name`, `durationMinutes`, `priceKobo`, `bufferMinutes`, `active`. Expose REST endpoints under `/api/services` and a `/app/services` UI.
tasks: Zod schemas for create and update
acceptance: Prices are stored in kobo as integers
Archived services are hidden from booking surfaces
